listing.name: Heretic (Crispy Doom family)
listing.summary: Use Heretic with its upstream crispy-doom Windows player and your own matching original game files. Setup and updates stay upstream-owned.

steps.title: Use this game’s original IWAD
steps.instruction: Supply HERETIC.WAD from your original PC Heretic copy. HERETIC1.WAD provides the separate limited shareware edition. Doom IWADs are not Heretic data. Keep your originals and edition identity; renaming another game’s WAD does not convert it. Use the upstream setup program to select your actual data and controls.

steps.title: Choose the player rather than its setup tool
steps.instruction: Extract the official Windows 64-bit crispy-heretic ZIP, retaining its DLLs and support files. Use crispy-heretic-setup.exe for upstream configuration when needed, then select crispy-heretic.exe with the extracted folder as its working directory. The setup and truecolor executables are separate choices. Change launch details can use two argument lines: -iwad, then the absolute path to your chosen heretic.wad. Registration does not run setup or start the game; Play is separate.

steps.title: Keep the actual save and configuration locations
steps.instruction: The reviewed Windows runtime normally keeps configuration and saves beside the player; explicit -config, -extraconfig and -savedir choices can redirect them. Preserve the whole working copy, actual chosen save/config folders, original IWAD and selected mods with all copies closed before replacing upstream files. Entries sharing the same engine folder can share settings and save slots; choose separate copies or explicit separate save/config locations for different games or Final Doom campaigns. Keep the old runtime until its saves work in the replacement. No managed backup or cross-version save compatibility is established.

steps.title: Keep upstream update ownership
steps.instruction: You and upstream maintain this external player, original files and profile. Portcove offers explicit registration, supervised Play and registration-only removal; it does not acquire ownership of the external files or offer managed Update, Backup, Rollback or deletion. Keep a working copy and back up its actual data before an upstream update. Other platforms need their own supported upstream package/application flow; this Windows guide does not establish native execution on any platform.
